# TenantProof

TenantProof is a productized, authorized tenant-boundary verification and remediation service for Supabase applications.

## Core claim
TenantProof tests whether one synthetic customer identity can read or modify another synthetic customer's in-scope data. It produces an executed matrix, redacted evidence, and—when purchased—reviewable policy patches and regression checks.

## Important limitations
- It is not a general penetration test.
- It is not a compliance certification.
- A passing check applies only to its documented environment, identity, code state, and time.
- Untested and out-of-scope paths are not treated as safe.
- Written authorization is mandatory before testing.
- The website never requests credentials or production records.

All named sample projects, findings, and remediation outcomes are fictional product demonstrations.
